keyFindings: Discovery is excellent: rich 29-key market schema, full orderbook depth, search, categories, history, live monitoring
Auth remains the critical blocker: CLI requires API key but no programmatic way to generate one
Private key alone is insufficient; API key is checked BEFORE private key is used for signing
Interactive setup wizard exists but cannot be automated (requires TTY input)
HMAC tokens from Limitless web UI are reportedly incompatible with CLI's X-API-Key header (from prior testing)
Trading command structure is complete: GTC limits, FOK market orders, cancel/batch-cancel, position tracking
Error messages are clear and actionable on discovery endpoints (404, 400 with format hints)
CLI is stateless per invocation — recovers cleanly after errors
No --dry-run or preview mode for trading commands

blockers.description: API key authentication incompatible with automated usage. CLI requires an API key that can only be generated via interactive setup wizard or the Limitless UI, but UI-generated HMAC tokens are incompatible with the CLI's X-API-Key header format. This blocks ALL trading, portfolio, and approval operations.
blockers.impact: All trading functionality (T1-T5) untestable. Portfolio queries blocked. An AI agent cannot authenticate to place trades.
blockers.possibleFix: Limitless needs to provide either: (1) a non-interactive API key generation endpoint, (2) fix HMAC token compatibility, or (3) support auth via private key signing alone (like Polymarket CLI does).
